about_the_game:
Learn in 5 minutes, master for hours: a deep yet accessible cozy idle game.

Allergic to animals? We’ve got you—this cozy cat care is 100% sneeze-free.

Focus, care, collect.

  • Use Pomodoro to manage your time, short, bite-size card mini-games, deeper upgrades, and long-term goals make every session feel worthwhile, all in hand-drawn pixel art.

  • Come say hi and help shape the game , bring your coffee and hang out with us. 

The Full Experience: A Heart-Warming Companion at the Bottom of Your Desktop

  • Expands the cozy core with a clearer layout, quicker actions, and smart panels that surface your pet's needs at a glance.

  • Unlock new behaviors, customize rooms, and automate daily tasks as you progress, all within a beautiful hand-drawn pixel art world shaped by community feedback.

  • It's the ultimate way to deepen your bond with your feline friend.

The Ultimate Pet Haven: 10+ Unique Animals

  • Introduces multi-pet management, letting you adopt 10+ unique species like raccoons, ferrets, capybaras, and cats, each with distinct traits and resource-digging behaviors.

  • Strategically manage their individual needs and relationships to unlock deeper progression, richer synergies, and smarter planning for your thriving animal home.

  • It's time to build a truly dynamic and engaging pet haven.

Deeper Care, Smarter Tools: Feed, Clean, Heal, Show Affection

  • Expands on core care with a richer system that includes pet bathing and environmental tools like summoning rain or snow to reduce germs.

  • Unlock helpful automations such as auto-feed and self-cleaning systems to streamline your routine.  These features deepen the care loop without adding busywork, allowing you to focus on the bond with your pet.

A World of Unique Shops: Items for Your Pet's Environment

  • Expands the economy with unique, species-specific shops for each of your animals, offering tailored items that boost their stats and unlock new animations.

  • Every item, from pillows for cats to tunnels for bunnies, comes with clear descriptions and tooltips so you know exactly what it does.

  • Decorations aren't just for show; they contribute to upgrades and even tie into your automations.

You'll purchase these unique items with resources your animals collect, creating a steady, self-sustaining economy. This system ensures every animal feels special and provides a deeper, more rewarding progression.

Evolving Your Desktop Space: Items for Your Pet's Environment

  • Customization system evolves with your gameplay, giving you advanced decoration styles and a massive selection of furniture and color variants.

  • You can transform your desktop with themed event packs and unlock entirely new environments and biomes, each with its own unique art style.

  • Your pet's space grows with you, reflecting your progress and creating a truly personal home for them. This expanded system ensures you can create a unique, dynamic desktop that’s always changing, not just a static background.

Work–Break Rhythm & Minimal Pomodoro

  • Customizable Productivity: Create custom presets, track your session stats, and get smart break reminders tailored to your workflow.

  • Curated Soundtrack: Dive into an expanded lo-fi library with an enhanced audio panel that offers effortless track swapping, custom playlists, and finer controls.

  • Natural Focus: These features are designed to make staying in the zone feel natural and effortless, turning your productivity into a seamless part of your day.

Mini Games: Short & Smart

  • Go beyond simple mini-games. Enrich your gameplay with multiple modes like score chases, daily challenges, and time trials. Add strategic depth with a wider variety of cards and modifiers that introduce new risk-and-reward twists. The rewards and power-ups you win will directly contribute to your long-term progression.

Achievement Haven: Joy to look

Our goal has been to create achievements that are not only a challenge to earn but also a joy to look at.

Even in the demo, we included nine unique achievements tied to the core care loops. We're committed to this philosophy, and in the full version, you can expect even more visually rich achievements to chase.
detailed_description:
Tiny Paws × $0.15 Donation is coming Q4 2025

Wishlist Tiny Paws today to get a heads-up when your new desktop companion arrives in Q4 2025. Here’s our promise: for every Steam sale of Tiny Paws, $0.15 goes to animals in need. We’ll keep everything transparent. Play a cozy game, make a real-world difference. By adopting a digital pet, you’re helping real ones get the care they need.


Tiny Paws is coming in Q4 2025!

I’ve always connected well with animals, and after graduating I wanted to combine my technical skills with that personal side. As a solo developer, I’m building Tiny Paws step by step under UPI Games. I’d love to have you with us on this journey—add it to your wishlist to be the first to know when your new desktop companion arrives.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS (64-bit) or equivalent modern distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent (Mesa drivers 20.x or newer)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly on most low-end Linux systems
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or later (SteamOS 3.0 compatible)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 or better (latest proprietary or Mesa
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or better
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for smoother experience
